helpers.tests/container/check-stock:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
checkout=$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/../.." && pwd)
stock_entrypoint_path=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
stock_entrypoint_hash=$(sha256sum "${stock_entrypoint_path}" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
# shellcheck source=tests/container/stock
source "${checkout}/tests/container/stock"
action=${1:-check}
case "${action}" in check|lint|test|build) ;; *) printf 'Unknown stock check: %s\n' "${action}" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
if (( $# > 1 )); then printf '%s\n' 'Stock checks do not accept extra arguments.' >&2; exit 2; fi
: "${PYTHON_IMAGE:?The Makefile declares PYTHON_IMAGE}"
stock_begin "${checkout}"
python_image=
markdown_image=
shellcheck_image=
stock_image python_image "${PYTHON_IMAGE}"
if [[ ${action} != build ]]; then
    stock_prepare "${python_image}" python -- sh tests/container/python prepare
fi
if [[ ${action} == check || ${action} == lint ]]; then
    : "${MARKDOWN_IMAGE:?The Makefile declares MARKDOWN_IMAGE}"
    : "${SHELLCHECK_IMAGE:?The Makefile declares SHELLCHECK_IMAGE}"
    stock_image markdown_image "${MARKDOWN_IMAGE}"
    stock_image shellcheck_image "${SHELLCHECK_IMAGE}"
    stock_prepare "${markdown_image}" markdown -- sh tests/container/markdown prepare
    stock_run "${python_image}" python -- sh tests/container/python lint
    stock_run "${markdown_image}" markdown -- sh tests/container/markdown lint
    stock_readonly "${shellcheck_image}" /bin/shellcheck -x -P SCRIPTDIR \
        configs/container/run tests/container/stock \
        tests/container/check-stock tests/container/python tests/container/markdown
fi
if [[ ${action} == check || ${action} == test ]]; then
    stock_run "${python_image}" python -- sh tests/container/python test
fi
if [[ ${action} == check || ${action} == build ]]; then
    if [[ ${action} == build ]]; then outputs=(dist); fi
    stock_run "${python_image}" '' -- sh tests/container/python build
fi
stock_finish
helpers.tests/container/python:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
case "$1" in
    prepare)
        python -m venv /scratch/venv >&2
        /scratch/venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.txt >&2
        exec tar --create --file - --directory / scratch/venv
        ;;
    lint)
        bash -n configs/container/run tests/container/stock tests/container/check-stock
        sh -n tests/container/python tests/container/markdown
        /scratch/venv/bin/ruff check .
        exec /scratch/venv/bin/ruff format --check .
        ;;
    test)
        exec /scratch/venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp=/scratch/pytest
        ;;
    build)
        python -m py_compile check-drift.py test_check_drift.py
        mkdir -p dist
        exec tar --create --gzip --file dist/github-config-drift.tar.gz check-drift.py configs
        ;;
    *) exit 2 ;;
esac
helpers.tests/container/markdown:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
case "$1" in
    prepare)
        mkdir -p /scratch/markdown
        cp tests/container/package.json tests/container/package-lock.json /scratch/markdown/
        npm ci --prefix /scratch/markdown --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --maxsockets=1 >&2
        exec tar --create --file - --directory / scratch/markdown
        ;;
    lint)
        exec /scratch/markdown/node_modules/.bin/markdownlint-cli2
        ;;
    *) exit 2 ;;
esac

python-sweep.requirements:
pytest==9.1.1
ruff==0.17.3
# The sweep parses each repository's lint config to compare the shared part, and
# reads the ShellCheck and markdownlint steps out of a workflow.
PyYAML==6.0.3

steps.name: Run test
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
source tests/container/stock
stock_begin "$PWD"
stock_image python_image "__PYTHON_IMAGE__"
stock_prepare "${python_image}" python -- sh -ec '
  python -m venv /scratch/venv >&2
  /scratch/venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.txt >&2
  tar --create --file - --directory / scratch/venv
'
stock_run "${python_image}" python -- /scratch/venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp=/scratch/pytest
stock_finish

steps.name: Run lint
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
source tests/container/stock
stock_begin "$PWD"
stock_image python_image "__PYTHON_IMAGE__"
stock_prepare "${python_image}" python -- sh -ec '
  python -m venv /scratch/venv >&2
  /scratch/venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.txt >&2
  tar --create --file - --directory / scratch/venv
'
stock_run "${python_image}" python -- sh -ec '
  bash -n configs/container/run tests/container/stock tests/container/check-stock
  sh -n tests/container/python tests/container/markdown
  /scratch/venv/bin/ruff check .
  /scratch/venv/bin/ruff format --check .
'
stock_image markdown_image __MARKDOWN_IMAGE__
stock_prepare "${markdown_image}" markdown -- sh -ec '
  mkdir -p /scratch/markdown
  cp tests/container/package.json tests/container/package-lock.json /scratch/markdown/
  npm ci --prefix /scratch/markdown --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --maxsockets=1 >&2
  tar --create --file - --directory / scratch/markdown
'
stock_run "${markdown_image}" markdown -- /scratch/markdown/node_modules/.bin/markdownlint-cli2
stock_image shellcheck_image __SHELLCHECK_IMAGE__
stock_readonly "${shellcheck_image}" /bin/shellcheck -x -P SCRIPTDIR \
  configs/container/run tests/container/stock tests/container/check-stock tests/container/python tests/container/markdown
stock_finish

steps.name: Pack the sweep and its canon
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
source tests/container/stock
stock_begin "$PWD"
stock_image python_image "__PYTHON_IMAGE__"
outputs=(dist)
stock_run "${python_image}" '' -- sh -ec '
  python -m py_compile check-drift.py test_check_drift.py
  mkdir -p dist
  tar --create --gzip --file dist/github-config-drift.tar.gz check-drift.py configs
'
stock_finish
